mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.25% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real gross domestic product (GDP) over the past six months indicates strong economic growth, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDP increased by more than 2% over the past six months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last month signals increased economic activity, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 1% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals deflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer demand and corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the consumer price index decreased by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When the number of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in the last month, it signals strong job growth, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls increased by more than 200,000 in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% and retail and food services sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% within the last month, it signals a strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both housing starts increased by more than 10% and retail and food services sales increased by more than 1% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% within the last month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate was above 4% and the consumer price index increased by more than 0.5% within the last month.
